# Deskflow Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We want the Deskflow community to be one where everyone can work together. We pledge to keep our community focused on the project and the code around the project.

## Community Standards

 * Keep interactions respectful and focused on the project
 * Interactions are between humans, Do not use AI to interact with the community use your own words not walls of generated text.
 * Contributions are expected to follow the [contribution guide](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/wiki/Contributing).
 * Please use English for all Interactions with the community, code comments and item names.

## Accaptable AI use for this project
 
 * We do not want to interact with AI through you. Do not use AI to write comments, issues, or PR descriptions.
 * You can use AI locally to develop, and when you make a PR you are expected to be responsible for the committed code.
 * You can use AI or a translate tool (such as Google Translate) to update translations.
 * Your AI must follow our code style from the [hacking guide](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/wiki/Hacking-Guide); e.g. do not use AI to generate verbose code comments, dont fix previous commits by adding commits, etc.

## Enforcement

Enforcement will be done at the descression of the Deskflow Moderators.

 1. Warning
 2. Temporary ban
 3. Permanent banning
